services.name: lizmap-init
services.command: sh -c 'mkdir -p /www/lizmap/var/db /www/lizmap/var/config /www/lizmap/var/log /www/lizmap/www && chown -R 1000:1000 /www/lizmap/var /www/lizmap/www && echo "server {" > /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && echo "    listen 80;" >> /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && echo "    server_name _;" >> /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && echo "    root /www/lizmap/www;" >> /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && echo "    index index.php index.html;" >> /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && echo "    client_max_body_size 100M;" >> /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && echo "    fastcgi_read_timeout 300;" >> /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && echo "    location / {" >> /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && echo "        try_files \$uri \$uri/ /index.php\$is_args\$args;" >> /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && echo "    }" >> /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && echo "    location ~ \.php$ {" >> /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && echo "        fastcgi_split_path_info ^(.+\.php)(/.+)$;" >> /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && echo "        fastcgi_pass lizmap:9000;" >> /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && echo "        fastcgi_index index.php;" >> /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && echo "        include fastcgi_params;" >> /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && echo "        fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME \$document_root\$fastcgi_script_name;" >> /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && echo "        fastcgi_param PATH_INFO \$fastcgi_path_info;" >> /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && echo "    }" >> /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && echo "}" >> /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && chmod 644 /www/lizmap/var/config/default.conf && echo "Config generated, sleeping..." && sleep infinity'
